fixture_33.mathematical_implication: Each identical treated/control anchor row forces A_i beta = 0 for every weak separating direction. Since anchor rank equals the full column count, beta=0 is the only such direction; therefore no nonzero weak separator exists. Full column rank then gives a finite, unique logistic MLE.
